title: No direct test of production SIID key-selection function; l2_key_selection suite drives a mirror
description: lichen/tests/l2_key_selection/main.c:195-222 drives rx_selected(), a mirror of the selection, over real frame.c/lichen_link_rx_payload primitives. peer_try_all_pubkeys itself is compiled only into Zephyr L2 objects and no Zephyr test references it (only tests/ping_l2 touches lichen_peer_add). Scenario: reintroducing trial-verify fallback inside peer_try_all_pubkeys fails no test in the repo. The suite docstring (main.c:13-14) claims the Zephyr-side peer table is exercised by Zephyr tests - that claim is not currently backed. Fix the docstring claim or add a Zephyr-side test referencing the function.
